downside: abs(min(mean(decimal ES close log returns over 1/5/22 retained rows), 0)); stored percentage returns divided by 100 as in latest HAR
selection: BIC on initial-history five-market plain VAR; same order for every VAR comparison
calendar: Frozen commodity-core HAR preparation: source-grid volatility windows, then all-five complete cases; yields excluded from core matching. Latest HAR yield join audited separately; provider timing unverified
evaluation: Shared next-row targets on frozen commodity calendar and 2023-07-12 cutoff; expanding fits; already examined and exploratory
fallback: last ES log variance when fit fails, dynamics are unstable or inputs are unavailable

irf.model: VAR + Downside (All 4: Oil + Corn + Gold + NG)
